description: Projectile events, record-only (context/designs/modding/projectile-events.md, slice 1). On Felicity with no simulants, player 0 is given each base weapon that throws or fires something (give_weapon) and uses it (a secondary function after ACTION_FIRE_MODE, as a player switches): both grenade functions, both N-bomb functions, the rocket launcher, the Slayer's rocket and its fly-by-wire rocket, both Devastator functions, the crossbow, the thrown combat knife, the three mines (the remote mine set off by its detonator), the Laptop gun's thrown sentry, the Super Dragon's grenade and the thrown Dragon. Each must log its spawn and a later event (bounce, landing, hit, end or detonation), and the Slayer's fly-by-wire rocket must not carry PROJECTILEFLAG_SLIDING (B-1261). The stage's totals go out at the scripted exit. Slice 3: each contact rule's first decision is logged with the modules the program chose and the ones the original rules choose (mines stick; a bolt and a thrown knife stick and pierce and land their own way, the knife poisoning; a rocket is spent by what it strikes; a Devastator round goes off where it comes to rest), and no decision may differ. Slice 4: each fuse's first decision is logged with what goes off and its explosion (a grenade, a rocket, the timed mine and the remote mine explode with their own explosion; the Super Dragon's grenade names explosion 21), and the remote mine's detonator is the remote signal rule spending its fuse. Slice 5: the Laptop gun's throw is the throw rule choosing a sentry. Slice 6: each object's first tick is the arm rule choosing the arm weaponTick runs for it (a grenade, the N-bomb and a grenade round count down, the wall hugger with its wall timer; a rocket has a struck fuse; each mine its own arm; the proximity items theirs; the bolt its own), and the arm the program chose must be the original's.

input_sequence.comment: Wait for first-person Combat Simulator gameplay.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_DEBUG_INVINCIBILITY
input_sequence.comment: Dev invincibility (the F7 action). The player stands in a small room and throws explosives at its walls; in the first run (2026-11-19) they died of their own grenade, rocket and grenade round, and everything fired during each respawn was lost. From every give to its first tap there are 3 s: the old weapon's unequip and the new one's equip took up to 2.4 s in that run.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Wall hugger: it hangs 2 s, drops and goes off.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Timed mine. It sticks and goes off on its own timer (4 s) before the proximity mine is out: thrown after it, in the first run, it set the proximity mine off and was blown up in the air.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Proximity mine. It is armed 4 s later; what is thrown past it after that sets it off.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: N-bomb on impact. The N-bomb comes last: its storm disturbs nothing after it.
